verdict.rationale: Oneleet's frameworks page names SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS and GDPR as supported on its all-in-one platform. The framework-removal docs show multiple frameworks share controls in one workspace, and pricing is pitched as one price with no per-framework fees. Missing for 10: framework-specific docs for HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS (control mappings, templates, audit workflow), and independent or hands-on confirmation that these frameworks work in practice beyond the marketing claim.
